acceptance_criteria.statement: A restart parses each landed outbox file at most twice (outbox file opens <= 2N on a mixed journal with recorded and missing events), not once per terminal attempt.
Outbox reads scale linearly: tripling the attempts at most ~triples the reads (b <= 3a + 6); a per-attempt full scan (O(N^2)) fails.
A restart reads the export index at most twice regardless of N (batched registration, no per-attempt _load_index/_reconcile).
All landed files recovered in one restart are registered in one batch: at most one export-index write, and exactly the missing events are created.
A restart opens at most 3 rails.sqlite writer connections, and the same number for N=6 and N=24 (one writer reused for recovery ingest and receipts).
Attempts whose landed record and receipt are already recorded are skipped: emit_landed_record and RailsEmitter.receipt are called for none of them, outbox reads <= N and writer opens <= 2.
A second restart writes nothing: no write-mode opens under events/, outbox files, export index bytes, rails event rows and receipts are unchanged.
Partial state (terminal journal written, outbox write lost) recovers exactly the missing events once; existing outbox files are untouched; index positions stay 1..N with no conflicts.
Conflicting evidence (journal state differs from the recorded landed event) is still detected and reported in landing_conflicts for exactly that attempt; the outbox is not changed.
An interrupted outbox write (torn dot-tmp file) is ignored and every attempt ends with exactly one landed event across two restarts.
A lost export index is rebuilt on restart with all N events and no conflicts, reading each outbox file a bounded number of times (<= 3N).
An interrupted receipt (outbox written, receipt append lost) is recorded on the next restart exactly once per attempt; a further restart adds no rails rows.
Notifier replay after a bounded restart delivers the same events in the same order as before (10/10).

assumptions: Counts come from a CPython audit hook ('open', 'sqlite3.connect') installed by the test module; it observes only and is gated to the restart under test.
A throwaway GREEN prototype (not committed) passed all 13 tests and the full existing suite (851 passed, 3 skipped), so the bounds are satisfiable without weakening any check.
Six ACs are regression guards that pass on main and must keep passing.

observable_behavior: outbox file opens per restart are O(N)
export index reads/writes per restart are O(1)
rails writer opens per restart are O(1)
a fully recorded journal restarts without emitting or appending
outcome.summary: Launcher startup recovery does one outbox scan into an attempt-indexed map, registers all recovered landed files in one batched export-index update, reuses one rails.sqlite writer for journal ingest and receipts, and skips attempts whose landed record and receipt already exist after a cheap read-only check. Conflict detection, partial-state recovery, interrupted-write recovery and notifier replay are unchanged. Fixes the O(N^2) restart (~414 s at 1297 attempts) in #106.
